purpose.summary: This batch program (ORCR0655) is part of the ORCA Japan Medical Association standard receipt (medical billing) software. It consolidates/aggregates same-item receipt line entries (同一剤のまとめ) across indexed files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE642, RECE64W) for medical claim processing. It reads receipt detail records, groups them by treatment category, and rewrites the consolidated results to working/output files.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims)

notable_features: Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, hence garbled)
COPY ... REPLACING with double-slash delimiter syntax
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes opened on the same physical file via different SELECT aliases (RECE642-FILE / RECE642X-FILE)
Job management sub-call (ORCSJOB) for step/cancel control
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM from LINKAGE SECTION
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM conditional on shell ID (RECEPTX)
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters in comments. The program is clearly part of the open-source ORCA medical receipt system (JMA, Japan). The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) that are not shown, so full data layout cannot be verified. The double-slash REPLACING syntax and overall structure are consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL as used in the ORCA project.
